title: Three Shifts and One Short Switch
subtitle: 工程建造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）
meta: 主题语境：工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）　|　核心词汇：model　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 model 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1981 the operator ① built the model that no trainee in the station would have noted, and he said the building was the whole of the shift. The ② model, meaning the copy itself and not the switch, ran three shifts and stayed unnoted in the book; a model, he said, is the only thing in a station that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ model in that station had the same short switch beside it, and the ④ model at the far screen, meaning the cable they kept for the children to check and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A model, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the operator said the noting is the part that fills three shifts.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the model was the whole of the matter, meaning the example and not the copy. The ⑥ model, meaning the example and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; model, he said, is either something you build or the only word that means both a copy and an example. He said the example is the part they remember.

By 1986 the ⑦ model had become a line in a log, and the log had become an argument about the short switch. The ⑧ model of the whole thing, the operator wrote in June, was one station and three shifts of noting; model, he said, is either the cable at the far screen or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ model I remember is the copy noted in the log, which closed in 1988 and is still noted as the quietest in the station. A ⑩ model, my mother said in 1990, is the only copy that improves by being noted; every model, she said, is an example that has agreed to look like a copy. She said the example was the honest half.

answers.why: build the model 意为“做这一个模型”，1981 年那位操作员把机房里没有一位实习生肯记下的一个模型做了一遍。
model 意为“模型；模范”，指那个模型本身而不是小小的开关，它经过了三个班次而在簿子上没有被记下。
model 意为“模型；模范”，指机房里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一个小小的开关。
model 意为“模型；模范”，指最远那块屏幕的留给孩子们查的那一根，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
model 意为“模型、榜样”，指一件事里人人都按却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个榜样就是那件事的全部。
model 意为“榜样”，指人人都按却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个模型，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
model 意为“模型；模范”，指运行日志里写到、被记下的那一个，到 1986 年这一个成了运行日志里的一行。
model 意为“模型之事”，操作员六月写道，整件事的模型之事是一处机房和三个班次的记下。
model 意为“模型；模范”，我记得的是运行日志里记下过的那一个，1988 年调好了，至今仍被说成机房里最安静的一个。
model 为抽象总称，母亲 1990 年说，模型是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的模型。
